description.value: Westview Oriental Restaurant has been serving Hong Kong-style Cantonese and Szechuan cuisine in North Vancouver since 2004. The menu spans dim sum classics, fresh seafood, and regional specialties like Peking Duck and Szechuan Ginger Beef, with the House Special Spicy Crab as a signature highlight. Online ordering is available, and the bilingual (English/Traditional Chinese) website reflects a well-established neighbourhood restaurant.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content was successfully fetched and confirms the restaurant name, address (#108 - 2609 Westview Drive, North Vancouver, BC), two phone numbers, and online ordering capability. No cycling-specific amenities (bike rack, Wi-Fi, water refill) are mentioned anywhere on the site. OSM tags confirm restaurant/Chinese cuisine but carry no address or phone to cross-check against the website.
concerns: OSM record has no address or phone; both sourced from website only.
Website lists two phone numbers (604-987-7799 and 604-987-2343); only the primary is stored in the phone field.
No postal code found on website for the address.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: The restaurant is a legitimate, active business that touring cyclists could visit for a full sit-down meal or takeout, but none of the required WWC criteria (bike parking/visibility, water refill, washrooms) can be confirmed from available evidence. A site visit or direct contact is needed to verify cyclist-friendly basics before including.
